Browser wait strategy 'fixed' waits for a specific duration after page navigation

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { BrowserMode, BrowserWait, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { extraWait: 100, mode: BrowserMode.Always, wait: BrowserWait.Fixed } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.browserUsed);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
}

void main();
```
